"""The payment flow, end to end: a separate process pays an amount plus its fee."""

import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

FLOW = """
import sys
from wallet.core import OverdraftError, withdraw
from wallet.fees import fee
balance, amount = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])
try:
    print(withdraw(balance, amount + fee(amount)))
except OverdraftError:
    print("refused")
    sys.exit(3)
"""


class PaymentFlowTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def pay(self, balance: int, amount: int) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", FLOW, str(balance), str(amount)], capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_pays_the_amount_and_the_fee(self) -> None:
        run = self.pay(1000, 250)
        self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 0, run.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(run.stdout.strip(), "747")

    def test_refuses_an_overdraft(self) -> None:
        run = self.pay(100, 250)
        self.assertEqual((run.returncode, run.stdout.strip()), (3, "refused"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
